status: exploratory feasibility; not E6 causal test
keyframe_policy: Defer normal tracking keyframe candidates until 2 seconds after last keyframe by recorded camera timestamp; retain all input frames. Relocalization may create keyframes outside this interval.
fixed_conditions: 512 input, same 240 mapping frames, base low-vram config, keyframe buffer 32, single_thread, same model weights
comparison: Compare keyframe timestamps and count, deferred proposals, logged tracking/relocalization, output validity and sampled GPU memory; no geometry efficacy claim without same-surface evaluation.
